period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account, read from National Bank's own Q1-2021 unaudited financial statements (OCR'd from a scanned PDF, but unusually clean -- every figure needed here is directly legible with no garbling). Comparative Balance Sheet column (31 Dec 2020) reproduces this dataset's existing FY2020 figures exactly: total_assets 529,313,255,416 (Solo+OBU consolidated-adjacent figure printed here is 529,313.26m; the plain Solo panel used throughout this dataset shows 529,052,549,451, matching FY2020's existing total_assets of 529052.55 exactly), total_equity 52,093,557,421, total_deposits 430,747,950,818 and gross_loans 408,510,601,258 all match FY2020 exactly, and nav_per_share matches (16.99). The entire P&L waterfall reconciles exactly and directly from printed figures with no derivation needed: Total Operating Income (2,182,048,948) = Net Interest Income (397,843,998) + Investment Income (1,249,401,662) + Commission (424,091,014) + Other Income (110,712,274); Profit Before Provision (529,754,219) = Total Operating Income - Total Operating Expenses (1,652,294,729); Profit Before Tax (429,754,219) = Profit Before Provision - Total Provision (100,000,000); PAT (309,754,219) = Profit Before Tax - Tax (120,000,000). This filing's own comparative (Jan-Mar 2020) column independently reproduces every one of 2020_Q1.json's P&L figures exactly, cross-validating both records. EPS (0.10) is the filing's own printed figure; its own Jan-Mar-2020 comparative EPS prints as 0.29, a small divergence from 2020_Q1.json's own contemporaneous 0.30 -- consistent with the 'Re-stated EPS' bonus-share-adjustment pattern documented elsewhere in this dataset (see sources.json); the contemporaneous 0.30 is kept in 2020_Q1.json per this dataset's standing rule.
